lines.en: label mayafirsthall:
scene mayahall1
: Hey, Maya. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : What makes you think it’s okay to just approach me in the hallway?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么觉得在走廊上就这么凑过来没问题？

lines.en: : The...fact that I am also in the hallway? And that we know each other. And that it is customary to greet the people you know.
lines.zh: : 凭……我也在走廊上？还有我们认识。还有跟认识的人打招呼是惯例。

lines.en: : Do you know Yumi as well?
lines.zh: : 你也认识 Yumi？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 认识。

lines.en: scene mayahall2
: Excellent. Go bother her instead, then. As you can see, I am in the middle of something very important.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那你去烦她吧。你也看到了，我正在做一件非常重要的事。

lines.en: : Are you? Because it looks to me like you’re just trying to open the door.
lines.zh: : 是吗？在我看来你只是在试图开门。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}just{/i} trying to open the door. I’m attempting to escape from a man who would likely attempt to sodomize me if we were alone in the hallway right now.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}只是{/i}在试图开门。我是在试图从一个男人身边逃走——如果我俩现在单独在走廊上，他大概会试图鸡奸我。

lines.en: : How come the two people who hate me the most had to choose today to hang out in the hall?
lines.zh: : 为什么最讨厌我的那两个人偏偏挑今天在走廊里晃？

lines.en: scene mayahall1
: Mondays, am I right?
lines.zh: : 星期一嘛，对吧？

lines.en: : Distaste for Mondays aside, what are you actually up to?
lines.zh: : 先不论你对星期一的厌恶，你到底在忙什么？

lines.en: scene mayahall3
: Why does it matter? It’s not like I’m planning on including you.
lines.zh: : 有什么关系？我又不打算把你算进去。

lines.en: : You’re kind of including me now by just responding to me.
lines.zh: : 你光是回应我，就已经算是把我算进去了。

lines.en: scene mayahall4
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Farewell.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Maya, wait.
lines.zh: : Maya，等等。

lines.en: scene mayahall5
: {i}Why?{/i} Am I seriously not even allowed to retreat into my own room without you attempting to get involved?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}难道我连退回自己的房间、你都要试图掺一脚？

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t plan on physically restraining you or anything. But would it kill you to converse with me for like, five minutes?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我不打算对你动手什么的。可跟我聊个五分钟会死吗？

lines.en: : That depends entirely on what we’d talk about. I’m sure there are plenty of conversation topics that would put an end to both of us in a matter of seconds.
lines.zh: : 那完全取决于我们要聊什么。我敢肯定有不少话题能在几秒内把我俩都了结了。

lines.en: : I highly doubt that’s-
lines.zh: : 我非常怀疑那——

lines.en: : You’re not even supposed to be here. You know that, right? This is a dorm for {i}girls.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你本来就不该在这儿。你知道的吧？这是{i}女生{/i}宿舍。

lines.en: : How are we supposed to feel safe at night if you’re standing outside of our doors, pressing your face against them and listening in on our conversations?
lines.zh: : 如果你站在我们门外、把脸贴在门上偷听我们说话，我们要怎么在夜里感到安全？

lines.en: : Just talk quieter if you’re worried about me listening in.
lines.zh: : 担心我偷听的话，小声点说不就行了。

lines.en: scene mayahall6
: So it falls on {i}us{/i} to traipse around your wrongdoings? Are you {i}that{/i} opposed to even the faintest trace of dignity?
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}要绕开你的错处走，反倒成了{i}我们{/i}的责任？你就这么抵触哪怕一丝一毫的尊严？

lines.en: : How about this? You hang out with me for the rest of the night and I promise to never press my face against your door without permission.
lines.zh: : 这样吧？你今晚剩下的时间陪我待着，我保证以后绝不未经许可就把脸贴在你门上。

lines.en: scene mayahall7
: Counter-offer: How about you walk yourself off the nearest bridge and never set foot in this hallway again?
lines.zh: : 反提议：要不你自己走到最近的桥上跳下去，永远别再踏进这条走廊？

lines.en: : Only if you walk off with me.
lines.zh: : 除非你陪我一起跳。

lines.en: : This...constant need to flirt with me will only make me hate you more, you know.
lines.zh: : 这种……不停撩我的需要，只会让我更恨你，你知道吧。

lines.en: : I actually figured you already hated me as much as possible. So it’s good knowing I’ve still got some time left to talk to you like this before we’re done for good.
lines.zh: : 我其实以为你已经恨我到顶了。所以知道在我俩彻底完蛋之前，我还有点时间能这样跟你说话，挺好的。

lines.en: : Anyway, do you come here often? I like your bell.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你常来这儿吗？我喜欢你的铃铛。

lines.en: : If you have some time, would you maybe want to go out for dinner or something?
lines.zh: : 如果你有空，要不要一起去吃个晚饭什么的？

lines.en: : Do not tempt me with free food. Not with that disgusting look on your face.
lines.zh: : 别拿免费的食物引诱我。别用你那张恶心的脸。

lines.en: : I think this is just how I look.
lines.zh: : 我想我本来就是这副样子。

lines.en: : It is. And it’s disgusting. Go away and never look at me again.
lines.zh: : 是的。而且很恶心。走开，永远别再看我。

lines.en: : Can you at least ask Ami to come out if you’re going to take that much exception to my existence?
lines.zh: : 既然你这么抵触我的存在，至少能叫 Ami 出来吗？

lines.en: scene mayahall8
: Ami isn’t home at the moment. May I take a message?
lines.zh: : Ami 这会儿不在。需要我帮你留言吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Tell her-
lines.zh: : 好。告诉她——

lines.en: : Sorry. This person’s voice mailbox is currently full. Please hang up and try again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。此人的语音信箱已满。请挂断后重试。

lines.en: scene mayahall7
: I am going back into my room now.
lines.zh: : 我现在要回房间了。

lines.en: : Do not attempt to follow me, and do not tell anyone that the two of us even {i}spoke{/i} tonight.
lines.zh: : 别想跟着我，也别告诉任何人我俩今晚{i}说过话{/i}。

lines.en: : Standing here and letting you hurl insults at me isn’t exactly {i}speaking.{/i}
lines.zh: : 站在这儿让你冲我吐口水，可算不上{i}「说过话」{/i}。

lines.en: : Then you should have no problem doing exactly as I told you just now.
lines.zh: : 那你照我刚才说的做，应该也没问题吧。

lines.en: scene mayahall2
: Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene mayahall0
scene black
Well...
You can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: 你不能说我没试过。

lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度不知怎么提升到了 [maya_love]！{/i}
